description: Cross-framework control mappings. Designed to be extended with additional frameworks (NIST CSF, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.) by adding entries to `frameworks` and `mappings`.

id_conventions.mapping_id: MAP-<8 hex chars> (deterministic md5(source|target)[:8]); stable across regenerations.
id_conventions.control_id: Native control identifier as published by the framework (e.g. SOC 2 'CC6.1', ISO 27001 'A.8.5').

soc2.name: SOC 2 (AICPA Trust Services Criteria, 2017 incl. 2022 points of focus)

indexes.by_soc2: Group `mappings` by `soc2_id` to list ISO controls covering a SOC 2 criterion.
indexes.by_iso27001: Group `mappings` by `iso27001_id` to list SOC 2 criteria addressed by an ISO control.

extensibility.add_framework: Append a new key under `frameworks` with `{name, publisher, controls:[{id,title}]}`.
extensibility.add_mapping: Append objects to `mappings` with fields {id, <source_framework>_id, <target_framework>_id, relationship, rationale}. Use deterministic md5(source|target)[:8] prefixed with 'MAP-' for the id.
